articleTitle: Enhancing Estimation Accuracy Of Psycho-Emotical State Of Operators Of Medical Exoskeletons As Intellectual Control Systems With High Degree Of Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: A method for speech commands processing, which increases the effectiveness of assessing a psycho-emotional state of operators of medical exoskeletons, is proposed. The method uses an adaptive processing method of empirical mode decomposition, and determines informative parameters relevant to a psycho-emotional component of speech commands.

articleTitle: Developing automotive production with using product lifecycle management system
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: Automotive production based on Hochschule Emden/Leer, Germany was created. Communicative interfaces were described. Product lifecycle management system was used in modelling of production and production itself. Created model will be used for implementation at Russian production.

articleTitle: Stiffness Analysis for Anthropomorphic Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this paper we consider the compliance modeling in anthropomorphic robot joints, which arises in the process of a walking. The stiffness model is obtained using the virtual joint modelling and describes the phase of the step in which only one of the legs is located on the surface. The results obtained in the simulation allow to reduce positioning error of the foot by more than 90% and zero momentum point by 60%.

articleTitle: Forced Synchronization of Central Pattern Generator of the Van Der Pol Oscillator With an Additional Feedback Loop
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This paper is dedicated to the study of the forced synchronization in van der Pol oscillator with an additional oscillatory circuit. The external signal is A cos ωt whose frequency is close to the natural frequency of the oscillator. Methods of the bifurcation analysis were used to construct the synchronization regions in parameter space. We show that strategies of control of central pattern generator based on the two-mode van der Pol oscillator can be developed using the variation of external influence.

articleTitle: Coupling analysis between thalamus and cortex in mesoscale model of spike-wave discharges from time series of summarized activity of model neurons
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The coupling analysis by the method of nonlinear adapted Granger causality of time series generated by the model of absence epilepsy was performed. In this case, the analyzed signals represent the total activity of a large number of directly connected neurons which are corresponded to a single structure. The results show that the method is able to determine the increase in coupling in terms of increasing the contribution of one population of neurons to the dynamics of another, but not in the sense of changing the magnitude of the coupling coefficients.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation and Investigation of the Phenomenon of Coherent Resonance in the Brain
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: We numerically modulate one- and multilayer network consisting of Rulkov neurons coupled to each other by chemical coupling, coupling strength was chosen randomly from some area of values. Couplings inside each layer are excitatory, but between layers a part of couplings are inhibitory and another one is excitatory. We discover the phenomenon of formation of space-time structures and investigate the influence of such parameters as network size, number of stimulated neurons, part of inhibitory couplings between layers and amplitudes of external stimulus and internal noise on it. We discover the phenomenon of coherent resonance depending from the parameters.

articleTitle: Parallel Method For The Numerical Solution Of The Laplace Equation Using Multiprocessor Systems:
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This report is devoted to the investigation of new methods for the numerical solution of the Laplace equation with multiprocessor systems. We investigate Dirichlet problem for a case of three-dimensional area with known border. The main idea of the method based on three-point formula and using the parallel programming paradigm. In final, we compare proposed numerical scheme and widely known “cross” scheme for solving this equation.

articleTitle: Multistability of macroscopic states in multilayer multiplex network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this paper, we observed the effect of multistable behavior of a multilayer multiplex network from the viewpoint of its state at the macroscopic level. In particular, it was shown that the emergence of multistability of the macro-state of a network is determined by the heterogeneity of its elements. By increasing the heterogeneity, the multilayer network passes from one absolutely stable state to another absolutely stable state through the multistability of the coexisting macroscopic attractors.

articleTitle: Complex Chimera States in a Nonlinearly Coupled Oscillatory Medium
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: We consider chimera states in a one-dimensional medium of nonlinear nonlocally coupled phase oscillators. Stationary inhomogeneous solutions of the Ott-Antonsen equation for a complex order parameter that correspond to fundamental chimeras have been constructed. Stability calculations reveal that only some of these states are stable. The direct numerical simulation has shown that these structures under certain conditions are transformed to breathing chimera regimes because of the development of instability. Further development of instability leads to turbulent chimeras.

articleTitle: Individual features of the dynamics of coupling from Time Series of Intracranial EEGs of Cortex of WAG/Rij’s Rats before and after of the drug
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this study, the intracranial EEG recordings are investigated with a mutual information function in the six intervals. Each rats was considered individually, the results are averaged across all categories. The results of the control group of rats and rats after administration of the drug — agonist of endocannabinoid receptors are compared.

articleTitle: Control of Human Psychophysiological Condition by the Neurointerface With Biological Feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: We analyze the possibility of controlling the characteristics of human brain activity during the processing of visual information using biofeedback. In order to activate feedback, we use biomarkers of electrical brain activity, which characterize the state of cognitive fatigue and reduce the subject's attention. Biological feedback is implemented in the form of an audio message informing the subject about the need to focus on the task.

articleTitle: Autonomous Power Supply System of Magnetron Generators Group
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The issues which emerge at autonomous power supply system development are considered. The objects of power supply are magnetron generators groups as part of technological complex with a distributed supply of microwave energy.

articleTitle: Inhibition Of Oscillations In A Heterogeneous Network Of Hodgkin-Huxley-Type Of Models
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In the present paper a network of two types of Hodgkin-Huxley-type of models is studied. The considered models demonstrate cognate behavior: (i) bursting attractor with unstable equilibrium; (ii) coexistence between bursting attractor and stable equilibrium (with very small basin of attraction of the stable equilibrium). In the case of heterogeneous network the conditions of occurring bitable dynamics is determined.

articleTitle: Construction of a depth map using stereo vision based on a developed stereo camera for the anthropomorphic robot AR600E:
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In the course of the work, a stereo camera was developed based on two Logitech C920 web cameras. Implemented methods for constructing a depth map in Python, reducing image distortion, rectification, manual methods were developed. Python methods of detecting objects on video, obtaining their coordinates for the implementation of inverse kinematics problems based on the anthropomorphic robot AR600E, are studied and implemented in Python.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Nonstationary Data: Application to the Processing of EEG
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: An overview of the current achievements in the development of data processing approaches that provide a correlation analysis of non-stationary, short and noisy time series is given. The application of these tools to recognize specific patterns in multi-channel electroencephalograms (EEG) is considered and the possibility of using correlation analysis in software for brain-computer interfaces is discussed.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Mathematical Analysis of Spatio-Temporal and Time-Frequency EEG Propertices for Human Personality Features Discover
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: We propose algorithm and analyze the spatio-temporal and time-frequency structure of multichannel EEG in humans completing Schulte tables and identified three groups of subjects, according to the scenario of neural activity. We believe that the results are of the great interest for testing and diagnostics. It allows to create automatic intelligent systems for estimation features of the human personality.

articleTitle: Generation of motion patterns with turns for bipedal walking robot based on actuated 3D Dual-SLIP model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this paper we put forward a method for generating motion patterns for bipedal walking robots based on the actuated 3D Dual-SLIP model. In the literature the actuated 3D Dual-SLIP model was used for motion without double support, i.e. running, planar walking or straight forward movement. In this work we demonstrate how motion patterns with turns can be obtained using linear quadratic controller.

articleTitle: Scaling Features Of Chaotic Dynamics In Interacting Systems Characterized From Noisy Data Sets
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this study we analyze the scaling features of chaotic motions in the dynamics of interacting systems from point processes contaminated with noise. We compare the effect of external fluctuations on the error of estimating the correlation characteristics of such motions and show that this effect is different for synchronous and asynchronous dynamics.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Path of Movement of the “Arm” Type Robot With Excessive Degrees of Freedom
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The direct and inverse geometric problems of motion of the “arm” type robot are considered. It is shown that the direct problem is solved uniquely. The inverse problem has many solutions, from which it is necessary to choose the optimal solution in each particular case. An example of calculation in the MATLAB environment for three-link robots of manipulators with six degrees of freedom at given angles of rotation of links is presented.

articleTitle: Features Of In-Phase Synchronization In The Model Of Coupled Neurons With Different Types Of Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In the present paper a model of coupled neuron with excitory and inhibitory coupling is considered. It is shown that the in-phase solution appears as a result of a sequence of period-doubling bifurcations of the degenerate period-l cycle. Multistability between in-phase and out-of-phase solutions is shown in the system.

articleTitle: Reduction of Vibration of a Rotor by Means of Combination of Bearings and Active Control of Their Dynamic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: Application of hybrid bearings, which combine rolling-element and sliding bearings allows significant improvement of dynamic characteristics and increase of lifetime of turbomachinery. In the present paper a general approach is presented for mathematical modeling of a hybrid bearing and of a control algorithm of its dynamic characteristics for rotor vibration minimization.

articleTitle: Dynamics of a Non-Autonomous Three-Mode Van Der Pol Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this work we consider a model of three-mode van der Pol generator with an external harmonic force. We show that in the case of existence of two limit cycles in the phase space of the system, a two-tongue structure is formed in the plane of parameters of external force. This structure allows one to switch between oscillatory regimes by varying of external force parameters.

articleTitle: Coherence of Low-Frequency Oscillations of Electroencephalogram and the Process of Autonomous Regulation of Heart Rhythm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The interaction between the low-frequency components of the signals of the electroencephalogram and the cardiointervalogram of a person during spontaneous breathing was revealed. Calculation of the coherence function with control of statistical significance allowed to detect a significant interaction of 0.1-Hz rhythms of these signals in the analysis of time series of three healthy subjects.

articleTitle: Detection of Couplings Between the EEG Signals During the Limb Movements
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: We used a method based on the modelling of phase dynamics to quantify the coupling strength between EEG channels. A distinction between the characteristics of coupling strength for the cases of limb movement and background activity is observed.

articleTitle: Development of a subsystem for calculating product lifecycle temporal parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The work purpose is to increase the efficiency of product lifecycle management. The purpose is achieved through the systematization of knowledge about the enterprise in the form of a ontology system. Ontology data is intended to provide semantic linking of information about the organization and organizational structures for effective management of the product lifecycle. Based on the enterprise ontology system, a JAVA program was developed for calculating the parameters of the lifecycle and tracking its status at the moment.

articleTitle: Modeling of threshold effects in information processes on the basis of neural networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This article covers the problems of modeling and forecasting of information processes in public systems and, in particular, the threshold effects in their dynamics. The author proposes the approach to describing the dynamics of information pro-cesses and their internal hierarchy depending on the scale of their influence on the state of the public system as a whole. The article also introduces the concept of a thresh-old effect for such processes.

articleTitle: Gender Differences in Operators Movement Recognition on Signals of Electroencephallogram
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: An important tool for studying brain activity is electroencephalography (EEG). The electrical signals of the brain of men and women, measured with EEG, show certain differences. A study was made of the gender-dependence of the quality of classification operators on EEG signals with the help of different types of artificial neural networks (ANN) of imaginary and real movements of hands and feet and the effect of the type of signal filtering on comparative classification characteristics. ANN made it possible to identify gender differences in the classification of operator movements according to EEG signals: in most of the cases considered, the quality of classification is higher for female operators. The application of data filtering in the majority of considered cases improves the quality of classification.

articleTitle: Synchronization In Cerebral And Peripheral Vessels Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: Synchronization plays an important role in the dynamics of living systems. However, its detection can be complicated due to a high level of noise in measured time series. In this work we consider the entrainment between the cerebral and peripheral blood flow in experiments performed in rats with laser speckle imaging. We show that this entrainment increases at the stroke development.

articleTitle: Method for Selecting Control Points on Spheres When Measuring on Coordinate Measuring Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: Spheres are widely used in various fields of technology. The task of measuring spheres is actual in surface metrology. A generally accepted technique for calculating sphericity is currently lacking. Three methods for determining sphericity are considered in the paper: spheres by the method of least squares, spheres of minimal volume, minimax sphere. The first two methods are known, and the latter method is proposed by the authors. Experiments were carried out for three schemes of location of control points on the sphere. As a result, recommendations are given on the application of methods for measuring sphericity in practice.

articleTitle: Influence of Stimulus Complexity on the Properties of Neural Activity During Perceptual Process
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This work is devoted to study of the features of time-frequency EEG structure, related to visual information processing in the brain. As a concrete example, the influence of stimulus complexity on the time-frequency EEG properties is considered. It is shown that an increase of visual stimulus complexity leads to an increase in the response amplitude of the neural network of the brain in the parietal and occipital cortex. It is associated with the excitation of the neural center of visual attention.

articleTitle: Scenarios for Physical Robot-Environment Interaction
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this paper, we focus is on the interaction between robot and the dynamically changing environment. According to the proposed approach, a collision is determined and an appropriate scenario of behavior and response is chosen, considering the nature of interaction and location of the contact point. The neural network is used to classify the collision, and the finite automaton selects appropriate reaction algorithms. The developed approach was tested on the robot Kuka LBR IIWA 14.

articleTitle: Application of Magnetoencephalography for Diagnostic of Brain Pathologies and Studying Cognitive Brain Abilities
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This lecture reviews technical, methodological and clinical advances in the study of brain functionality by means of magnetoencephalography (MEG). After historical overview of pioneering works of some research groups in this field, neurophysiological and biomagnetism bases of MEG are presented and technical developments in superconducting detectors (SQUID, Superconducting Quantum Interference Device), signal processing, enhancement of signal-to-noise ratio and dipole modeling are described.

articleTitle: High-Precision Servo Drives Technological Robots. Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The main results of the research and the main principles of construction of precision geared mechatronic drives for technological robots, which contain elastic mechanical transmissions with backlash in the closed position control loop of the manipulator links, are presented. The results of computer simulation show significant increase in accuracy of movements of technological robots with the suggested type of drives, and also show advisability of their implementation both for operations without force contact between the manipulator tool and processed object, and with such contact.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Bearings With Elastic Elements and Active Regime Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The present paper considers adaptive rotor bearings of high-speed turbomachines. The mechatronic gas dynamic bearings are chosen with elastic surface. Authors suggest using multilayer foils with bimorph piezoelectric elements that operate in the generator regime to determine the deformation of elastic elements and in the actuator regime to form an optimal bearing's surface.

articleTitle: Chaotic Oscillations of Complex Mechanical Nanostructures in the Field of Color Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The mathematical model of a two-layer nanosystem is constructed, which consists of Kirchhoff nanoplasties and Euler-Bernoulli nanoballs connected through boundary conditions under the influence of transverse load and color noise. The contact interaction between nanoplate and nanoball is taken into account by the model of B.Ya. Cantor. He studies the influence of color noise on the contact interaction.

articleTitle: Mobile Agent’s Motion Planning in Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This paper presents navigation task of mobile robot as multicriterial optimization problem of path length and risk probability. Approach based on combination of global path-planning algorithms and methods of “soft” computations are proposed. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Problems of “Thin” Management of the Artificial Limb When Developing the Interface the Brain-Computer in Domestic Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The aim of the work is to develop a brain-computer interface (BCI) which is a system of human communication with a machine (for example, with a computer or prosthesis), based on the direct transformation of human intentions reflected in the brain biopotentials, into control commands. The data obtained in the course of the study will allow to implement the BCI for the construction of a multifunctional individual prosthesis with a sensitivity function and a full range of sensations.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dynamics and Contact Interaction of Complex Beam-Shell Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The mathematical model of the contact interaction of two enclosed cylindrical shells, reinforced by a beam from the outside with a liquid in the gap between the shells and without it, is constructed in this paper. An alternating load distributed on the surface acts on the beam. Chaotic spatial oscillations of the described structures are studied from the standpoint of methods of nonlinear dynamics. The problem solved with using the finite element method.

articleTitle: Wavelet-Based Methods For Signal Denoising
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: We discuss several wavelet-based methods for signal denoising including the discrete wavelet-transform with real-valued basic functions and two variants of the complex wavelet-transform. We show the advantages of the latest approaches for different examples of noisy time series.

articleTitle: Time-frequency analysis of EEG during the observation of educational material
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: In this work, we study the time-frequency characteristics of the electroencephalogram (EEG) of subjects in the process of observation of educational material. In the course of the analysis, the main differences in EEG spectral characteristics in the process of cognitive activity from background activity were revealed, the main features associated with energy distribution over alpha, beta, and delta bands were determined. Also, a comparison of the spectral composition of the EEG in the process of viewing neutral video and educational material is made, characteristic differences in the dynamics of beta-rhythm in the frontal and occipital lobes are distinguished.

articleTitle: The Specificity and Characteristics of Elastic Links of Vibroprotective Systems With Positioning Elements
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: This article analyzes the results of studies of the dynamic properties of a vibration protection system with an elastic link of intermittent action. The conditions under which the nonresonant transfer function is provided in the range of the perturbation frequencies under study are determined.

articleTitle: Statistical Properties of the Phase Synchronization Index Between Autonomic Regulatory Rhythms:
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The paper is devoted to diagnostics of phase synchronization of the autonomic regulatory contours of blood circulation according to experimental data. Using the method of diagnostics of phase synchronization intervals of the cardiovascular system regulation processes we studied the statistical properties of quantitative estimates of synchronization, where special attention is paid to the choice of the length of the experimental signals.

articleTitle: Mathematical methods of analysis of the MEG brain data:
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The method of recurrent analysis was applied to the MEG brain data, obtained during the execution of imaginary movements by the subjects. The purpose of the method was to determine, for the subjects, significant data for further analysis of these channels in the performance of imaginary movements. It is shown that in the course of the experiment, the subjects have significant channels in the prefrontal cortex, especially in the pre-moto and somatomotor zones, as well as in the occipital lobe, if the subject was asked to present the motion visually.

articleTitle: About Evaluation of Layered Dielectric Filling Influence on Dominant Mode Cutoff Wavelength of Lunar Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: Quasi-analytical expression allowing evaluating the influence of electro-physical parameters of layered dielectric filling and geometrical sizes of lunar waveguide on its dominant mode cutoff wavelength are considered.

articleTitle: Reconstruction and Modeling of Coupling Architecture in the Brain at Limbic Epilepsy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The coupling change effect on the development of pathological activity is very important. To identify temporal evolution of coupling structure in the brain using Granger Causality, we propose the following steps: to determine main temporal-frequency properties of the signal, to construct simplified models of signal sources which reproduce the considered activity main properties, to adjust the method parameters to maximize its sensitivity and specificity using series simulated from the simplified models.

articleTitle: Real-Time Big EEG Data Processing With CUDA Parallel Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: Possibility of parallel computing technology application for big EEG data processing was considered. It was shown, that application of such methods for calculation of time-frequency characteristics of multichannel EEG signals allows real-time evaluation of changes in EEG signal and, therefore, in brain neuronal activity. Possibility of realization of wavelet-based algorithm for detection of characteristic states and changes of states on EEG signals in real time with help of CUDA C library was shown.

articleTitle: Experimental Assembly With Multi-Zone Lubrication Active Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd School on Dynamics of Complex Networks and their Application in Intellectual Robotics (DCNAIR)
abstract: The present paper features description of an active control system for a multizone lubricant supply module of a test rig used to study influence of a temperature-viscosity wedge on characteristics of fluid-film bearings. Elements of the measuring system are shown of the featured rotor system. An algorithm is presented of the experimental bearing's operation and specifically of the `flowmeter-servovalve' system's operation. Design diagram is shown and perspective ways of improvement of the presented module are discussed.

abstract: The following topics are dealt with: medical signal processing; electroencephalography; neurophysiology; brain; time series; bifurcation; neural nets; chaos; rotors (mechanical); cognition.
